_comment: Copy this file to videos.json and replace the entries with your own footage.
The set must hold between 2 and 5 videos. 'role' is 'development' for videos the
ROI polygons and parameters were calibrated on, and 'final' for videos the
reported comparison is measured on; the two are reported in separate sections of
the comparison table. 'visible_approaches' lists the approaches actually in
frame, and 'resolution' is [width, height]. Keys beginning with an underscore
